title: Forgiveness that becomes fearlessness
subtitle: For the wound that needs release without denial
description: Follow forgiveness from received mercy into courage, so the heart can stop guarding the wound as if bitterness were protection.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Forgiveness becomes fearless when mercy loosens the self-protection built around injury.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Release one claim to retaliation while still telling the truth about what happened.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey frames forgiveness as courage born from mercy, not as pretending the wound was small.
evidence.turn: Fear loosens when mercy makes the heart less dependent on bitterness for safety.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the harm truthfully, then lay down one rehearsed punishment you keep carrying.
